info.name: PromoQuoter API
info.description: Cart pricing and stock reservation service. Run the folders in order (or use the Collection Runner): the create requests save ids into collection variables that later requests use. Start the service first with ./mvnw spring-boot:run (http://localhost:8080). The Rules folder shows the generic rule engine: pricing and validation rules, free gifts, preview and the 422 RULE_VIOLATION. Every error is an RFC 7807 problem with code, requestId and errors[].

request.description: type RULE with a per-cart "when", a per-line "target" and one action. Conditions combine with all, any and not and compare with eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, between, in, notIn, startsWith and contains. Stage defaults by action (PERCENT_OFF is 100). Saves ruleId.

response.name: 201 - Create pricing rule (generic)
400 - every problem reported with its field path
422 - a condition references an unknown product

request.description: A VALIDATION rule rejects the cart when its conditions match, so you write the violation. It runs after all pricing rules on the final discounted cart, for quote and confirm. Saves validationRuleId.

response.name: 201 - Create validation rule
400 - a pricing action in a validation rule

request.description: FREE_GIFT adds a separate zero-priced line and reserves its stock when the order is confirmed. If the gift is out of stock it is skipped and noted. Cart-level actions (AMOUNT_OFF_CART, SURCHARGE, SHIPPING_WAIVER) work the same way. Saves giftRuleId.
